heroHeadline: Security Council Warns Peace Deals Are Failing to Halt DRC Fighting as Ebola Deaths Reach 3,901
heroSubtitle: On Sept 29 the UN Security Council met on the DRC, where government forces and M23 keep fighting despite peace agreements, with the southern Masisi offensive stalled short of Ngungu and clashes continuing toward Katoyi and Ngululu. Rising DRC-Rwanda tensions and allegations of over 300 deaths in areas held by Rwandan forces and M23 were raised. The Ebola (Bundibugyo) outbreak has passed 8,000 confirmed cases and 3,901 deaths as of Sept 26 across seven provinces.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
